[profile.default]
# Retry once so one transient failure does not fail full-CI outright.
# Fanout keeps the full-CI shards moving without treating every >30s test as
# stuck. Keep this aligned with the broader timeout budget we give sharded CI.
slow-timeout = { period = "30s", terminate-after = 2 }
retries = 1

[profile.default.junit]
path = "junit.xml"

[profile.local]
# Nextest 0.9.103 inherits custom profiles from default implicitly.
# The optional inherits key requires Nextest 0.9.115 or newer.

[profile.local.junit]
# Declare the output on the profile selected by `just test` explicitly, also
# for CI's pinned Nextest 0.9.103. Missing reports must fail the collection gate.
path = "junit.xml"

[test-groups.app_server_protocol_codegen]
max-threads = 1

[test-groups.app_server_integration]
max-threads = 1

# Higher concurrency causes integration test timeouts under resource contention
# on common developer machines.
[test-groups.app_server_integration_local]
max-threads = 4

[test-groups.core_apply_patch_cli_integration]
max-threads = 1

[test-groups.windows_sandbox_legacy_sessions]
max-threads = 1

[test-groups.windows_process_heavy]
max-threads = 2

[[profile.default.overrides]]
# Do not add new tests here
filter = 'test(rmcp_client) | test(humanlike_typing_1000_chars_appears_live_no_placeholder)'
slow-timeout = { period = "1m", terminate-after = 4 }

[[profile.default.overrides]]
filter = 'test(approval_matrix_covers_all_modes)'
slow-timeout = { period = "30s", terminate-after = 2 }

[[profile.default.overrides]]
filter = 'package(codex-app-server-protocol) & (test(typescript_schema_fixtures_match_generated) | test(json_schema_fixtures_match_generated) | test(generate_ts_with_experimental_api_retains_experimental_entries) | test(generated_ts_optional_nullable_fields_only_in_params) | test(generate_json_filters_experimental_fields_and_methods))'
test-group = 'app_server_protocol_codegen'

[[profile.default.overrides]]
# These integration tests spawn a fresh app-server subprocess per case.
# Keep the library unit tests parallel.
filter = 'package(codex-app-server) & kind(test)'
test-group = 'app_server_integration'

[[profile.local.overrides]]
# Use up to four app-server subprocesses locally. The global nextest pool still
# limits this to the machine's logical CPU count.
filter = 'package(codex-app-server) & kind(test)'
test-group = 'app_server_integration_local'

[[profile.default.overrides]]
# These tests exercise full Codex turns and apply_patch execution, and they are
# sensitive to Windows runner process-startup stalls when many cases launch at once.
filter = 'package(codex-core) & kind(test) & test(apply_patch_cli)'
test-group = 'core_apply_patch_cli_integration'

[[profile.default.overrides]]
# These tests create restricted-token Windows child processes and private desktops.
# Serialize them to avoid exhausting Windows session/global desktop resources in CI.
filter = 'package(codex-windows-sandbox) & test(legacy_)'
test-group = 'windows_sandbox_legacy_sessions'

[[profile.default.overrides]]
# This Codex-home startup path still exceeded the broader Windows-heavy ceiling
# in both Windows full-CI lanes after contention was reduced.
platform = 'cfg(windows)'
filter = 'test(start_thread_uses_all_default_environments_from_codex_home)'
slow-timeout = { period = "1m", terminate-after = 2 }

[[profile.default.overrides]]
# These Windows-heavy tests spawn subprocesses, session files, or JSON-RPC
# clients and have been the dominant source of 30s full-CI timeouts.
platform = 'cfg(windows)'
filter = 'test(suite::resume::) | test(suite::cli_stream::) | test(suite::auth_env::) | test(start_thread_uses_all_default_environments_from_codex_home) | test(connect_stdio_command_initializes_json_rpc_client_on_windows)'
test-group = 'windows_process_heavy'
slow-timeout = { period = "45s", terminate-after = 2 }

# These correctness/measurement cases deliberately retain thousands of real
# fsyncs plus acknowledged recovery. Their workload is not a 60-second product
# latency SLO. Keep all records and durability checks, serialize the heavy disk
# cases, and retain bounded watchdogs rather than skipping them. The explicit
# signed growth measurement also creates thousands of independent signatures;
# its 10-minute harness budget is not a runtime latency acceptance threshold.
[test-groups.hepta_durable_capacity]
max-threads = 1

[[profile.default.overrides]]
# This opt-in qualification starts real companion windows and performs several
# original SQLite writer close/reopen and acknowledged receipt transactions.
# Keep every operation deadline and assertion; bound the complete durable run
# separately from the ordinary 60-second unit-test watchdog. Never retry a
# killed lifecycle automatically, because it owns real child processes.
filter = 'package(codex-hepta-agentd) & test(notes_actual_app_crash_original_owner_reopen_and_helper_ack_restart)'
test-group = 'hepta_durable_capacity'
slow-timeout = { period = "30s", terminate-after = 8 }
retries = 0

[[profile.default.overrides]]
filter = 'package(codex-hepta-learning-ledger) & test(history_exceeds_v1_record_capacity_without_resetting_chain_or_limits)'
test-group = 'hepta_durable_capacity'
slow-timeout = { period = "30s", terminate-after = 6 }

[[profile.default.overrides]]
filter = 'package(codex-hepta-learning-ledger) & test(signed_product_history_curve_append_lookup_reopen_and_exact_retry)'
test-group = 'hepta_durable_capacity'
slow-timeout = { period = "30s", terminate-after = 20 }
retries = 0

# Measure all four growth/reopen points and 256 real atomic domain commits.
# This full storage experiment preserves operation leases, child deadlines and
# the product latency acceptance threshold.
[[profile.default.overrides]]
filter = 'package(codex-hepta-operations) & test(growing_history_keeps_early_identity_and_domain_count_after_restart)'
test-group = 'hepta_durable_capacity'
slow-timeout = { period = "30s", terminate-after = 20 }
retries = 0

# These scenarios install and verify real release binaries, then run multiple
# separately bounded lifecycle phases. Serialize the complete scenarios and
# bound their total workload independently of each original operation deadline.
# A killed lifecycle owns child processes and must never retry automatically.
[[profile.default.overrides]]
filter = 'package(codex-hepta-supervisor) & (test(=five_real_pairs_adopt_all_ten_children_and_isolate_one_matrix_crash) | test(=two_real_pairs_restart_one_without_peer_pid_churn))'
test-group = "hepta_durable_capacity"
slow-timeout = { period = "30s", terminate-after = 12 }
retries = 0
